note: Wikidata q-ids only. Seven of the ten Explorer spots for this city had usable q-ids in docs/world/research/explorer-pins.json; three did not, and one of the seven was matched to the wrong building. All four are handled below. No entrance is claimed: no door here has been measured, so every point is the centroid or area it actually is. CENTRE: this is Wikidata's point for the Innere Stadt, Vienna's first district (Q267329), and not Wikidata's point for the city itself (Q1741). The city's own coordinate sits 19 m from the cathedral, because whoever set it chose Stephansplatz, so using it made the audit report the cathedral as a centroid mistake. That was a false positive: the cathedral has its own distinct coordinate and is exactly where it should be. The fix belongs on the reference point, not on the place.
